title: Shopping Cart
description: A shopping cart with a product catalog. Add and remove items (priced from the catalog), then check out to charge a bank account. Checkout is a cross-Thing effect.

items.title: Items
items.description: Item ids currently in the cart.

totalAmount.title: Total Amount
totalAmount.description: Sum of the catalog prices of the items in the cart.

availableProducts.title: Available Products
availableProducts.description: The catalog: each product has an identifier, name and price.

addItem.title: Add Item
addItem.description: Add the catalog item with the given id to the cart.

removeItem.title: Remove Item
removeItem.description: Remove one instance of the given item id from the cart.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.description: Empty the cart and charge its total to the given bank account. A checkout of an empty cart (total 0) changes nothing and reports success false.
checkout.vre:effects: items' = totalAmount > 0 ? [] : items; totalAmount' = totalAmount > 0 ? 0 : totalAmount; bankAccount.balance' = totalAmount > 0 ? bankAccount.balance - totalAmount : bankAccount.balance; output.success = totalAmount > 0; output.userId = this.id; output.charged = bankAccount; output.amount = totalAmount;
